title: Properties panel: instance X/Y position fields missing from InstanceView
description: InstanceView in PropertiesPanel shows W/H read-only and instance name/blend/color-effect, but there are no editable X and Y numeric inputs. Flash 8 shows X/Y next to W/H. Fix: add X and Y NumInput fields to InstanceView that read/write the displayObj.x and displayObj.y properties via the existing stage_update mechanism.
